title: Photocatalytic aerobic oxidation: matched 420 nm source
protocol: Fmoc-L-methionine (3.7 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (10 mol%) were dissolved in acetonitrile at 0.10 M. The solution was exposed to air and irradiated with a 1.5 W LED centered near 420 nm at 21 C for 5 min. Fmoc-methionine sulfoxide was formed in 99% yield.
objective: Design a conservative first gas-liquid photochemical flow screen using the validated 420 nm excitation window.
hard_constraints: The light source must be between 410 and 430 nm.
Liquid flow must be at least 0.01 mL/min.

design_input_text:
RAW BATCH PROTOCOL:
Fmoc-L-methionine (3.7 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (10 mol%) were dissolved in acetonitrile at 0.10 M. The solution was exposed to air and irradiated with a 1.5 W LED centered near 420 nm at 21 C for 5 min. Fmoc-methionine sulfoxide was formed in 99% yield.

OBJECTIVE:
Design a conservative first gas-liquid photochemical flow screen using the validated 420 nm excitation window.

HARD CONSTRAINTS:
- Use only the listed inventory.
- The light source must be between 410 and 430 nm.
- Liquid flow must be at least 0.01 mL/min.
- Report inlet/STP and pressure-corrected in-channel gas flow separately.
